summary: Specialize the shared pi-family launcher to its native callers

replay.detail: Both current callers already use native launch; provider argv, session directory selection, admission-before-claim and terminal fencing retain their existing behavior.

schema.detail: No binding/checkpoint schema, stored-state reader, wire format or historical data cleanup changes.

rules.detail: Native session token creation, ownership, inherited catalog environment removal and OMP resume fences remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Removes the unused required-incarnation and legacy-presence options from the workspace-internal shared launch helper. Its only callers already passed None and false. Current native launch and adoption APIs, immutable hook compatibility and the interrupted-ask-resume bridge remain.

downtime.detail: No active provider restart is required.

manual.detail: No operator action or stored-state cleanup is required.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the unused source options without rewriting stored state.
